# DivestOS Linux 3.18 CVE/hardening backport for bach

Applied **737** patches (**669** distinct CVEs) on top of kernel 3.18.140 + the camera ISP fix (commit 14d1af6a).
Patches from the DivestOS database (gitlab.com/divested-mobile/kernel_patches), applied with strict `git apply` (clean context match) via DOS_CVE_BACKPORT_patcher.sh.
Verified: builds (GCC 4.9), boots, no panics, camera/Wi-Fi/GPU/audio working.
